AUTOGENSTUDIO_DEFAULT_USER_ID='guestuser@gmail.com' -- all data namespaced under this shared identity in no-auth mode

Serve mode: autogenstudio serve --port 8084 (single-team endpoint, no UI)

uvicorn ASGI server; single worker default

React SPA served from / (static build); /api mounted as sub-application
WebSocket endpoint /api/ws/runs/{run_id} for live agent execution streaming
MCP integration via /api/mcp/ WebSocket bridge for tool server connections
pivot_paths: /api/teams/?user_id=guestuser@gmail.com -- team/agent configurations with full component specs
/api/runs/?user_id=guestuser@gmail.com -- all agent run history including task and team_result fields
/api/settings/?user_id=guestuser@gmail.com -- user settings including LLM model config

vulnerabilities.title: auth_type=none default -- all routes accessible as guestuser@gmail.com
vulnerabilities.details: AuthConfig model default: type='none'. AuthMiddleware: 'if self.auth_manager.config.type == "none": request.state.user = await self.auth_manager.authenticate_request(request)'. authenticate_request() with type=none returns User(id='guestuser@gmail.com', name='Default User', provider='none'). No token required. All agent/team/session/run data is accessible. NoAuthProvider() also used as fallback on any provider init failure.

vulnerabilities.title: Missing JWT secret accepts all tokens in auth-enabled modes
vulnerabilities.details: AuthManager.is_valid_token(): 'if not self.config.jwt_secret: return True'. create_token() with no jwt_secret: 'return "dummy_token_" + user.id'. If AUTOGENSTUDIO_JWT_SECRET is not set and auth is nominally enabled, any string is a valid token.

vulnerabilities.title: Single shared identity guestuser@gmail.com in no-auth mode
vulnerabilities.details: All data created in no-auth mode is namespaced under user_id='guestuser@gmail.com'. Any unauthenticated accessor reaches all sessions, teams, runs, and settings created by any user. No per-user isolation.

vulnerabilities.title: Unauthenticated MCP WebSocket bridge allows arbitrary tool server connections
vulnerabilities.details: When auth_type=none, /api/mcp/ routes (WebSocket bridge for stdio/SSE/HTTP MCP servers) are accessible without credentials. An attacker can initiate connections to arbitrary MCP servers from the host running AutoGen Studio, potentially pivoting to internal services.

vulnerabilities.title: SQLite database in CWD with predictable name
vulnerabilities.details: Default DATABASE_URI='sqlite:///./autogen04203.db'. Database filename is hardcoded in config. May be directly accessible via /files/ static mount if CWD and static root overlap in misconfigured deploys.

auth_evidence: autogenstudio/web/auth/models.py AuthConfig: 'type: Literal["none", "github", "msal", "firebase"] = "none"'. autogenstudio/web/auth/manager.py authenticate_request(): 'if self.config.type == "none": return User(id="guestuser@gmail.com", name="Default User", provider="none")'. AuthMiddleware: auth_type=none path skips all token extraction and validation. AUTOGENSTUDIO_AUTH_TYPE env var must be explicitly set to enable auth.
